note: Used as a measure word: 一集, 第三集.

ex.en: I watched three episodes last night.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 kek6 zung2 gung6 jau5 gei2 do1 zaap6
ex.en: How many episodes does this series have?

ex.r: zeoi3 hau6 jat1 zaap6 hou2 hou2 tai2
ex.en: The last episode was really good.

note: Measure word 隻. 搭船 = take a ferry; 暈船 = seasick.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 daap3 syun4 heoi3 coeng4 zau1
ex.en: We're taking the ferry to Cheung Chau.

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 co5 syun4 zau6 wan4
ex.en: I get seasick as soon as I'm on a boat.

ex.r: haa6 jat1 baan1 syun4 gei2 dim2 hoi1
ex.en: What time does the next ferry leave?

note: In casual talk 做完 or 搞掂 is more common.

ex.r: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3
ex.en: I finally finished the report.

ex.s: 呢幅拼圖我哋一齊完成。
ex.r: ni1 fuk1 ping3 tou4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 jyun4 sing4
ex.en: We finished this jigsaw puzzle together.

ex.s: 佢上個月完成咗第一個馬拉松。
ex.r: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 jyun4 sing4 zo2 dai6 jat1 go3 maa5 laai1 cung4
ex.en: He finished his first marathon last month.

en: to ride (bus, car, train); take transport

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 daap3 ce1 heoi3 ding6 haang4 heoi3 aa3
ex.en: Should we ride there or walk?

ex.r: ngo5 daap3 ce1 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 tai2 syu1
ex.en: I often read while I'm riding.

ex.r: keoi5 daap3 ce1 faan1 gung1 jiu3 jat1 go3 zung1
ex.en: Her commute to work takes an hour.

note: Casual alternative: 包埋 (include too).

ex.s: 個價錢包唔包括早餐呀？
ex.r: go3 gaa3 cin4 baau1 m4 baau1 kut3 zou2 caan1 aa3
ex.en: Does the price include breakfast?

ex.s: 張單已經包括咗服務費。
ex.r: zoeng1 daan1 ji5 ging1 baau1 kut3 zo2 fuk6 mou6 fai3
ex.en: The bill already includes the service charge.

ex.r: baau1 kut3 ngo5 jat1 gung6 jau5 ng5 go3 jan4
ex.en: Including me, there are five people.

note: Very casual; 阿爸 is neutral. Use about your own or friends' dads.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 dau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 diu3 jyu2
ex.en: My dad loves fishing.

ex.r: nei5 lou5 dau6 gei2 si4 teoi3 jau1 aa3
ex.en: When is your dad retiring?

ex.r: ngo5 daa2 bei2 lou5 dau6 man6 haa5 sin1
ex.en: Let me call my dad and ask first.

note: 冇精神 = tired, listless.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 zing1 san4 wo3
ex.en: You look full of energy today.

ex.r: fan3 dak1 m4 gau3 sing4 jat6 mou5 zing1 san4
ex.en: Not getting enough sleep, I'm always tired.

ex.r: jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 zing1 san4 di1
ex.en: Have a coffee to perk up.

note: Often split: 退咗休 = has retired.

ex.r: keoi5 ming4 nin2 zau6 teoi3 jau1 laa3
ex.en: He's retiring next year.

ex.r: teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: After I retire I want to travel.

ex.r: ngo5 je4 je2 teoi3 jau1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4
ex.en: My grandpa has been retired for many years.

note: HK word; Mandarin uses 質量.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 saam1 zat1 sou3 hou2 hou2
ex.en: The clothes at this shop are great quality.

ex.r: peng4 je5 zat1 sou3 tung1 soeng4 maa4 maa2
ex.en: Cheap stuff is usually so-so quality.

ex.r: zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3 hou2 gou1
ex.en: The hotel's service is top quality.

note: Measure word 張.

ex.r: ngo5 deng6 zo2 heoi3 dung1 ging1 ge3 gei1 piu3
ex.en: I booked a flight to Tokyo.

ex.r: sing3 daan3 zit3 gei1 piu3 hou2 gwai3
ex.en: Plane tickets are expensive at Christmas.

ex.r: nei5 zoeng1 gei1 piu3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much was your plane ticket?

ex.s: 嗰次去日本真係好開心。
ex.r: go2 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
ex.en: That trip to Japan was so much fun.

ex.s: 你記唔記得嗰次我哋蕩失路？
ex.r: nei5 gei3 m4 gei3 dak1 go2 ci3 ngo5 dei6 dong6 sat1 lou6
ex.en: Remember that time we got lost?

ex.r: go2 ci3 zi1 hau6 keoi5 mou5 zoi3 ci4 dou3
ex.en: After that time he was never late again.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 aa3
ex.en: Can you speak Cantonese?

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 po4 gaau3 ngo5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: My wife is teaching me Cantonese.

ex.r: ni1 go3 zi6 jung6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 dim2 gong2
ex.en: How do you say this word in Cantonese?

note: 惡做 = hard to do; 惡搵 = hard to find.

ex.r: zek3 gau2 hou2 ok3 m4 hou2 dim6 keoi5
ex.en: That dog is fierce, don't touch it.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 lou5 sai3 hou2 ok3 gaa3
ex.en: Our boss is really strict.

ex.r: ni1 tau4 di1 ce1 wai2 hou2 ok3 wan2
ex.en: Parking spots are hard to find around here.

note: The usual HK word for an apartment. Measure word 個.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 zou1 zo2 go3 loeng5 fong2 daan1 wai2
ex.en: We rented a two-bedroom flat.

ex.r: go3 daan1 wai2 deoi3 zyu6 go3 hoi2
ex.en: The flat faces the sea.

ex.r: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 sap6 lau2 ge3 daan1 wai2
ex.en: She lives in a flat on the tenth floor.

en: a while back; some time ago
note: Also 前排. 呢排 = these days, lately.

ex.r: cin4 go2 paai2 ngo5 hou2 mong4
ex.en: I was really busy a while back.

ex.r: ngo5 cin4 go2 paai2 heoi3 zo2 taai3 gwok3
ex.en: I went to Thailand a while ago.

ex.s: 前嗰排佢病咗，而家好返喇。
ex.r: cin4 go2 paai2 keoi5 beng6 zo2 ji4 gaa1 hou2 faan1 laa3
ex.en: She was sick a while back, but she's better now.

en: to pass (a test); meet the standard
note: Fail = 唔合格, or slangy 肥佬.

ex.r: ngo5 haau2 ce1 paai4 zung1 jyu1 hap6 gaak3 laa3
ex.en: I finally passed my driving test!

ex.r: keoi5 sou3 hok6 caak1 jim6 m4 hap6 gaak3
ex.en: He failed the math quiz.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 wai6 sang1 m4 hap6 gaak3
ex.en: This restaurant failed its hygiene inspection.

note: 甩色 = fade (color); 甩頭髮 = lose hair.

ex.r: ngo5 gin6 saam1 lat1 zo2 lap1 nau2
ex.en: A button came off my shirt.

ex.s: 呢條褲洗咗幾次就甩色。
ex.r: ni1 tiu4 fu3 sai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 zau6 lat1 sik1
ex.en: These pants faded after a few washes.

ex.s: 呢排壓力大，甩咗好多頭髮。
ex.r: ni1 paai2 aat3 lik6 daai6 lat1 zo2 hou2 do1 tau4 faat3
ex.en: I've been stressed lately and lost a lot of hair.

note: 唔准 = not allowed.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 m4 zeon2 sik6 jin1
ex.en: No smoking here.

ex.r: aa3 maa1 m4 zeon2 ngo5 gam3 je6 faan1
ex.en: Mom won't let me come home so late.

ex.r: lou5 sai3 zeon2 zo2 ngo5 fong3 saam1 jat6 gaa3
ex.en: My boss approved three days off for me.

ex.r: nei5 lai4 dou3 daa2 bei2 ngo5 laa1
ex.en: Call me when you get here.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 dou3
ex.en: We just got here.

ex.s: 啲嘢食嚟到就即刻食啦。
ex.r: di1 je5 sik6 lai4 dou3 zau6 zik1 hak1 sik6 laa1
ex.en: Eat the food as soon as it arrives.

note: 今朝 = this morning; 聽朝 = tomorrow morning.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 ci4 zo2 hei2 san1
ex.en: I got up late this morning.

ex.r: ting1 ziu1 baat3 dim2 hai2 lau4 haa6 dang2
ex.en: Wait downstairs at eight tomorrow morning.

ex.s: 佢由朝到晚都喺度做嘢。
ex.r: keoi5 jau4 ziu1 dou3 maan5 dou1 hai2 dou6 zou6 je5
ex.en: She works here from morning till night.

note: Usually followed by 都.

ex.r: mui5 ci3 gin3 keoi5 keoi5 dou1 hou2 mong4
ex.en: Every time I see her, she's busy.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 ci3 heoi3 dou1 giu3 ni1 go3 caan1
ex.en: I order this set meal every time I go.

ex.s: 每次落雨我都唔記得帶遮。
ex.r: mui5 ci3 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1
ex.en: Every time it rains I forget my umbrella.

note: Often split: 排咗好耐隊 = queued a long time.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2
ex.en: You have to queue for this restaurant.

ex.r: m4 goi1 paai4 deoi2 aa3
ex.en: Please line up.

ex.r: hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5 san1 sau2 gei1
ex.en: Lots of people are lining up to buy the new phone.

ex.r: ngo5 co5 syun4 co5 dou3 soeng2 au2
ex.en: The boat ride makes me want to throw up.

ex.r: keoi5 sik6 co3 je5 au2 zo2 sing4 maan5
ex.en: He ate something bad and threw up all night.

ex.s: 個嬰兒飲完奶嘔咗啲出嚟。
ex.r: go3 jing1 ji4 jam2 jyun4 naai5 au2 zo2 di1 ceot1 lai4
ex.en: The baby spat up a little after drinking milk.

note: 黑色 = black (color).

ex.r: tin1 haak1 laa3 ngo5 dei6 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: It's getting dark, let's go home.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gin6 haak1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3
ex.en: I want to buy a black jacket.

ex.r: gaan1 fong2 hou2 haak1 hoi1 dang1 laa1
ex.en: The room is dark, turn on the light.

note: Measure word 張.

ex.r: ngo5 tai2 sau2 gei1 dei6 tou4 wan2 lou6
ex.en: I use the map on my phone to find my way.

ex.r: zau2 dim3 jau5 mou5 min5 fai3 dei6 tou4 aa3
ex.en: Does the hotel have free maps?

ex.r: nei5 hai2 dei6 tou4 dou6 zi2 bei2 ngo5 tai2
ex.en: Show me on the map.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 soeng1 dong1 gwai3
ex.en: Things here are quite expensive.

ex.r: keoi5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 soeng1 dong1 hou2
ex.en: He speaks Cantonese quite well.

ex.s: 今日塞車塞得相當犀利。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 sak1 ce1 sak1 dak1 soeng1 dong1 sai1 lei6
ex.en: The traffic was pretty bad today.

note: 好可憐 = poor thing.

ex.r: zek3 maau1 hou2 ho2 lin4 mou5 jan4 joeng5
ex.en: The poor cat has no one to look after it.

ex.s: 佢病咗仲要返工，好可憐。
ex.r: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zung6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 hou2 ho2 lin4
ex.en: Poor guy, he's sick and still has to work.

ex.r: ngo5 jan4 gung1 siu2 dou3 hou2 ho2 lin4
ex.en: My salary is pitifully low.

note: Measure word 個. Casual: 差人.

ex.r: jau5 me1 si6 zau6 wan2 ging2 caat3
ex.en: If anything happens, go to the police.

ex.r: go3 ging2 caat3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zi2 lou6
ex.en: The police officer gave us directions.

ex.r: keoi5 go3 sai3 lou2 soeng2 zou6 ging2 caat3
ex.en: Her little brother wants to be a police officer.

note: 沖涼 = take a shower.

ex.r: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zik1 hak1 cung1 loeng4
ex.en: I shower as soon as I get home.

ex.r: ngo5 bong1 nei5 cung1 bui1 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I'll make you a cup of coffee.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 cung1 ci3 so2 aa3
ex.en: Remember to flush the toilet.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 syut3 gwai6 tip3 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 zai2
ex.en: I stuck a note on the fridge.

ex.r: gei3 seon3 jiu3 tip3 jau4 piu3
ex.en: You need to put a stamp on to mail a letter.

ex.r: ngo5 tip3 zo2 di1 soeng2 soeng5 mong5
ex.en: I posted some photos online.

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 cit3 di1 cung1
ex.en: Cut some green onions for me.

ex.r: saang1 jat6 daan6 gou1 dang2 aa3 po4 cit3 laa1
ex.en: Let Grandma cut the birthday cake.

ex.s: 個蘋果切開一半，一人一份。
ex.r: go3 ping4 gwo2 cit3 hoi1 jat1 bun3 jat1 jan4 jat1 fan6
ex.en: Cut the apple in half, one piece each.

ex.s: 你咳得好嚴重，睇醫生啦。
ex.r: nei5 kat1 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6 tai2 ji1 sang1 laa1
ex.en: Your cough is bad, go see a doctor.

ex.r: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 m4 hai6 hou2 jim4 zung6
ex.en: Don't worry, it's not that serious.

ex.r: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 zung3 duk6 hou2 jim4 zung6
ex.en: My computer has a bad virus.

ex.s: 我今年嘅目標係減十磅。
ex.r: ngo5 gam1 nin2 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 gaam2 sap6 bong6
ex.en: My goal this year is to lose ten pounds.

ex.s: 公司今個月嘅目標好高。
ex.r: gung1 si1 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 muk6 biu1 hou2 gou1
ex.en: The company's target this month is really high.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 ding6 go3 muk6 biu1 sin1
ex.en: You need to set a goal first.

en: to go to class; have class
note: 落堂 = class is over.

ex.r: ngo5 gau2 dim2 jiu3 soeng5 tong4
ex.en: I have class at nine.

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 m4 hou2 waan2 sau2 gei1
ex.en: Don't play on your phone in class.

ex.s: 我今晚要上堂，學煮嘢食。
ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 soeng5 tong4 hok6 zyu2 je5 sik6
ex.en: I have a cooking class tonight.

note: 左手邊 = left-hand side. Right is 右.

ex.r: gwo3 zo2 maa5 lou6 zyun3 zo2
ex.en: Turn left after you cross the road.

ex.r: sai2 sau2 gaan1 hai2 nei5 zo2 sau2 bin1
ex.en: The restroom is on your left.

ex.r: ngo5 zo2 goek3 hou2 tung3
ex.en: My left foot really hurts.

ex.s: 佢識講普通話同廣東話。
ex.r: keoi5 sik1 gong2 pou2 tung1 waa2 tung4 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: She speaks Mandarin and Cantonese.

ex.r: ngo5 ge3 pou2 tung1 waa2 maa4 maa2 dei2
ex.en: My Mandarin is so-so.

ex.r: hok6 haau6 jau5 pou2 tung1 waa2 tong4
ex.en: The school has Mandarin classes.

note: Measure word 間. 睇戲 = watch a movie.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hei3 jyun2 tai2 hei3 laa1
ex.en: Let's go to the movies.

ex.r: hei3 jyun2 jap6 min6 hou2 dung3
ex.en: It's cold inside the theater.

ex.r: soeng1 coeng4 deng2 lau2 jau5 gaan1 hei3 jyun2
ex.en: There's a cinema on the mall's top floor.

en: to get done; sort out; handle

ex.r: fan6 gung1 fo3 gaau2 dim6 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Is the homework done yet?

ex.r: fong3 sam1 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5
ex.en: Don't worry, I'll handle it.

ex.r: din6 nou5 di1 man6 tai4 gaau2 dim6 zo2 laa3
ex.en: The computer problems are fixed.

ex.r: nei5 gaa3 kei4 jau5 me1 gai3 waak6 aa3
ex.en: Any plans for the holiday?

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 nin2 zung6 jau5 ng5 jat6 gaa3 kei4
ex.en: I still have five vacation days this year.

ex.r: coeng4 gaa3 kei4 di1 gei1 piu3 hou2 gwai3
ex.en: Flights are expensive over long holidays.

note: For solid chunks: 一嚿蛋糕, 一嚿石頭.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 gau6 ngau4 paa2 cat1 sing4 suk6
ex.en: I'll have a steak, medium-well.

ex.s: 佢一個人食咗三嚿蛋糕。
ex.r: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 zo2 saam1 gau6 daan6 gou1
ex.en: She ate three pieces of cake by herself.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 dei6 haa2 jau5 gau6 sek6 tau4
ex.en: Careful, there's a rock on the ground.

ex.s: 你可唔可以陪我去睇醫生？
ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1
ex.en: Can you come with me to the doctor?

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 hai2 uk1 kei2 pui4 zai2 neoi2
ex.en: I'm staying home with the kids tonight.

ex.s: 佢陪咗我行街成個下晝。
ex.r: keoi5 pui4 zo2 ngo5 haang4 gaai1 sing4 go3 haa6 zau3
ex.en: She went shopping with me all afternoon.

note: Measure word 間. Mandarin uses 商店.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2
ex.en: There are lots of shops on this street.

ex.r: di1 pou3 tau2 sap6 dim2 sin1 hoi1 mun4
ex.en: The shops don't open until ten.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 wong6 gok3 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 pou3 tau2
ex.en: He opened a shop in Mong Kok.

note: 跑步 = jog, go running.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 paau2 bou6
ex.en: I go running in the park in the morning.

ex.r: keoi5 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3
ex.en: He runs really fast.

ex.r: m4 hou2 hai2 wing6 ci4 bin1 paau2 aa3
ex.en: Don't run by the pool!

note: 買保險 = buy insurance.

ex.r: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 gei3 dak1 maai5 bou2 him2
ex.en: Remember to buy insurance when you travel.

ex.r: gung1 si1 jau5 ji1 liu4 bou2 him2
ex.en: The company provides medical insurance.

ex.r: gaa3 ce1 ge3 bou2 him2 gei2 si4 dou3 kei4
ex.en: When does the car insurance expire?

note: Same as 禮拜. 星期一 = Monday; 星期日 = Sunday.

ex.r: ngo5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 heoi3 toi4 bak1
ex.en: I'm going to Taipei next week.

ex.r: nei5 sing1 kei4 gei2 dak1 haan4 aa3
ex.en: Which day are you free?

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4 faan1 ng5 jat6 gung1
ex.en: I work five days a week.

note: Often one's family's ancestral village or hometown.

ex.r: nei5 hoeng1 haa2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3
ex.en: Where's your family's hometown?

ex.r: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 faan1 hoeng1 haa2
ex.en: We go back to our hometown for Chinese New Year.

ex.r: hoeng1 haa2 di1 hung1 hei3 hou2 hou2
ex.en: The air in the countryside is great.

note: 拖手 = hold hands; 拍拖 = to date.

ex.r: m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa3 faai3 di1 zou6 laa1
ex.en: Stop putting it off, just do it.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 to1 zyu6 sau2 haang4 gaai1
ex.en: They're walking around hand in hand.

ex.s: 我拖住個行李箱上樓梯。
ex.r: ngo5 to1 zyu6 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1 soeng5 lau4 tai1
ex.en: I dragged my suitcase up the stairs.

note: Before a noun it means the whole: 全公司 = the whole company.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 cyun4 hai6 jau4 haak3
ex.en: It's all tourists here.

ex.r: keoi5 cyun4 san1 sap1 saai3
ex.en: He's soaking wet all over.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 cyun4 gung1 si1 dou1 fong3 gaa3
ex.en: The whole company has tomorrow off.

ex.s: 你嚟香港嘅目的係乜嘢？
ex.r: nei5 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 mat1 je5
ex.en: What's the purpose of your visit to Hong Kong?

ex.s: 我學廣東話嘅目的係同外母傾偈。
ex.r: ngo5 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 tung4 ngoi6 mou2 king1 gai2
ex.en: I'm learning Cantonese so I can chat with my mother-in-law.

ex.r: keoi5 gam3 zou2 lai4 jat1 ding6 jau5 muk6 dik1
ex.en: She came this early, she must be up to something.
